scope: Classical algebraic BRST/BV-BFV and Gauss system of K1346's repository-owned scalar electrodynamics; not the source GU KT/BV-BFV complex and not an analytic properness theorem.

interacting_complex.interaction_witness: both E_A and G contain matter bilinears and E_phi contains A through D
interacting_complex.brst_rules: sA=d c, s phi=i e c phi, s c=0
interacting_complex.brst_nilpotence: s^2 A=0 and s^2 phi=0 by s c=0, graded Leibniz and c^2=0
interacting_complex.classical_bv_action: S_BV=S_SED+integral(A_star d c+2 Re<phi_star,i e c phi>)
interacting_complex.classical_master_equation: (S_BV,S_BV)=0 follows from gauge invariance and the abelian closed gauge algebra
interacting_complex.koszul_tate_role: the antifield differential sends A_star and phi_star to E_A and E_phi, while c_star records the Noether identity
interacting_complex.bfv_nilpotence: {Omega_boundary,Omega_boundary}=0 because the U(1) Gauss constraints Poisson commute
interacting_complex.boundary_reduction: degree-zero BFV functions are gauge-invariant functions on the Gauss surface modulo local U(1)
interacting_complex.common_algebraic_core: smooth finite Fourier fields and ghosts with K-finite H_ps matter values

claim_ceiling: K1346 has one interacting classical gauge complex with exact Noether, Gauss, BRST, BV-master and boundary-BFV algebra on a common smooth core. This does not prove a closed functional KT resolution, global BV-BFV properness, interacting Green theory or identification with the released GU action.
